violated_assumptions: Assumption: Vector passed as string '[...]' should be rejected or cause type mismatch
Reality: REST v2 API silently coerces string-serialized float vectors to actual float32 arrays via json.Unmarshal in utils.go:548

contract_refs: No explicit constraint in structured_contract.json forbidding vector data as JSON-serialized string
Contract allows 'data' field with flexible JSON types - type coercion is by-design in REST v2 layer

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: REST v2 Insert Request → parseInsertData() → utils.go getRowDataFromJson() → case DataType_FloatVector → json.Unmarshal([]byte(dataString), &vectorArray) → Silent coercion from JSON string to []float32
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现: utils.go:548 对 FloatVector 字段使用 json.Unmarshal([]byte(dataString), &vectorArray)。当 vector 传入为字符串 "[0.1,0.2,0.3,0.4]" 时,dataString 为该字符串,json.Unmarshal 会将其解析为正确的 []float32 数组。这是有意的设计(REST API 灵活性),非缺陷。

falsification.observed: Query returned id=0, vector=[0.1,0.2,0.3,0.4] - data correctly stored and retrievable. No data corruption or type mismatch.

cognition_match.developer_quote: REST v2 API fails to properly serialize/deserialize complex data types (shape_id: rest-v2-data-type-handling). However, this case shows the API DOES properly deserialize string-serialized vectors via json.Unmarshal - it's by-design flexibility, not a bug.
cognition_match.note: 虽然命中了 REST v2 data type handling 模式,但本案例显示该处理是正确的(字符串成功解析为数组),非缺陷。

contract.explicit_requirement: No contract constraint explicitly forbids vector data as JSON-serialized string in REST v2 insert payload

physical.objective_constraint: Float vector field expects numeric array, but no physical law prohibits JSON string serialization

verdicts.rationale: REST v2 API 有意设计为灵活接受 vector 字段为 JSON 字符串或数组。源码 utils.go:548 使用 json.Unmarshal([]byte(dataString), &vectorArray) 处理 FloatVector,当传入字符串 "[0.1,0.2,0.3,0.4]" 时成功解析为 []float32 数组。复现证实插入成功,查询返回正确数据,无数据损坏。这是 API 设计的灵活性(by-design),非缺陷。
